name: products_list
description: List products. Searches the catalog. Filter by category, active status, price range (cents) or name text. Sorted by SKU. Use this to find a product id or SKU before other calls. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the product name.

name: products_create
description: Create a product. Adds a product to the catalog, on sale, with zero stock in every warehouse. Allowed roles: owner.

sku.description: Unique SKU: "SKU-" and at least four digits.

name: products_get
description: Returns one product, including its current price and whether it is still sold. Pass either id or sku (for example SKU-0042, case-insensitive). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

name: products_update
description: Update a product. Changes name, description, price (cents) or active flag. Send only the fields to change. active=false discontinues the product. Allowed roles: owner.

name: products_bulk_price_update
description: Change many prices at once. RISKY: changes the price of every product in a category, or of a list of SKUs, by a percentage or to a fixed price. dryRun defaults to true and only previews the changes; send dryRun=false to apply them. Existing orders keep the prices they were placed at. Allowed roles: owner.

category.description: Change every product in this category. Give category OR skus, not both.

skus.description: Change exactly these SKUs (1 to 200). Give category OR skus, not both.

changePercent.description: Percent change, -90 to 500. 10 raises prices by 10%. Give changePercent OR setPriceCents.

setPriceCents.description: Set every matched product to this price in cents. Give changePercent OR setPriceCents.

dryRun.description: true (default) only previews the changes. Send false to apply them.

name: inventory_list
description: List stock levels. One row per product per warehouse (east, west). Filter by warehouse, product, or lowStock=true to find items that need reordering. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

productId.description: Only rows for this product id.

lowStock.description: true = only rows where available stock (onHand - reserved) is below the reorder level.

name: inventory_for_product
description: Get stock for one product. Stock in every warehouse for one product, plus the total available to sell. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

name: inventory_adjust
description: Correct a stock count. Adds or removes on-hand units in one warehouse, for example after a recount or damage. The reason is kept in the audit log. Use shipments_create to ship orders, not this. Allowed roles: owner, warehouse.

delta.description: Units to add (positive) or remove (negative), -10000 to 10000, not 0. On-hand stock can never drop below the units reserved for open orders.

reason.description: Why the count changed. Kept in the audit log.

name: customers_list
description: List customers. Sorted by name. Filter by name or email text, loyalty tier, or country code. Use this to find a customer id from a name or email. Allowed roles: owner, support.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the name or email.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, IN.

name: customers_get_by_id
description: Get a customer by id. Returns contact details, address, loyalty tier and notes for one customer. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: customers_update
description: Update a customer. Changes phone, address (replaced as a whole) or notes. Send only the fields to change. Name and email are not editable here. Allowed roles: owner, support.

notes.description: Replaces the notes. Empty string clears them.

name: customers_list_orders
description: List a customer's orders. All orders placed by one customer, newest first. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: orders_list
description: List orders. Newest first. Filter by status, customer id, placement date range (from/to), minimum total in cents, or coupon code. To find late deliveries use orders_delayed instead. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

from.description: Start of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601.

to.description: End of the date range (exclusive), ISO 8601.

customerId.description: Only orders from this customer id.

couponCode.description: Only orders that used this coupon code.

name: orders_create
description: Create an order. Creates a pending order for a customer. Prices come from the catalog (not the request), the coupon must be usable now, and stock is reserved in one warehouse. Use forms_order_form first to see the fields, current coupon codes and role-specific options. Allowed roles: owner, support.

customerId.description: Customer id. Find it with customers_list (search argument).

items.description: 1 to 20 lines. Each SKU at most once; use quantity for more units.

sku.description: Product SKU. Find it with products_list.

warehouse.description: Default: the first warehouse that has every item in stock.

couponCode.description: Coupon code. Must be usable now (see forms_order_form for current codes).

manualDiscountCents.description: Extra discount in cents, on top of any coupon. Owner only.

name: orders_delayed
description: List delayed orders. Orders whose shipment is still in transit after its estimated delivery date, most overdue first. Each item has the order, its shipment and how many days late it is. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

name: orders_get
description: Returns one order with its line items, totals in cents, coupon and notes. Pass either id or number (for example ORD-10042, case-insensitive). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

name: orders_cancel
description: Cancel an order. RISKY: stops the order for good. Only pending or paid orders can be cancelled; their reserved stock goes back to the warehouse. Shipped orders need a refund instead. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: orders_mark_paid
description: Mark an order as paid. Moves a pending order to paid, so the warehouse can ship it. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: orders_update_notes
description: Replace the notes on an order. Overwrites the free-text notes of an order. Send an empty string to clear them. Allowed roles: owner, support.

notes.description: Replaces the current notes. Empty string clears them.

name: shipments_list
description: List shipments. Most recently shipped first. Filter by status, carrier, order id, or delayed=true for shipments still in transit after their estimated delivery date. Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

orderId.description: Only shipments for this order id.

delayed.description: true = still in transit after the estimated delivery date.

name: shipments_create
description: Ship a paid order. Creates a shipment with a new tracking number for a paid order. The order becomes shipped, and its reserved units are removed from the warehouse stock. Allowed roles: owner, warehouse.

orderId.description: Id of a paid order to ship.

name: shipments_get
description: Returns carrier, tracking number, status and the shipped, estimated and delivered dates of one shipment. Pass either id or trackingNumber (for example TRK00000010). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

name: shipments_deliver
description: Mark a shipment as delivered. Records delivery now. The order becomes delivered. Allowed roles: owner, warehouse.

name: refunds_list
description: List refunds. Newest request first. Filter by status, reason, order id, request date range (from/to), or minimum amount in cents. Allowed roles: owner, support.

from.description: Start of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601.

to.description: End of the date range (exclusive), ISO 8601.

orderId.description: Only refunds for this order id.

name: refunds_request
description: Request a refund. RISKY: creates a pending refund for a shipped or delivered order. The amount counts against the order at once and cannot exceed what is left to refund. Money moves only when the owner approves it with refunds_approve. Allowed roles: owner, support.

orderId.description: Id of a shipped or delivered order.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents. At most what is left to refund on the order.

name: refunds_get_by_id
description: Get a refund by id. Returns one refund: amount in cents, reason, status and dates. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: refunds_approve
description: Approve a refund. RISKY: completes a pending refund, so the money goes back to the customer. Allowed roles: owner.

name: refunds_reject
description: Reject a refund. Declines a pending refund with a reason. Its amount no longer counts against the order. Allowed roles: owner.

name: coupons_list
description: List coupons. Sorted by code. Filter by active flag or kind. Each coupon includes "usable": whether it can be applied right now (active, not expired, uses left). Allowed roles: owner, support.

active.description: true = switched on by staff. Expiry is separate.

name: coupons_create
description: Create a coupon. Adds an active coupon. kind=percent takes value% off; kind=fixed takes value cents off. Codes are capital letters and digits. Allowed roles: owner.

value.description: Percent off (1 to 100) for percent coupons, or cents off for fixed coupons.

expiresAt.description: Expiry, ISO 8601. Must be in the future.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of uses. Omit for unlimited.

name: coupons_get_by_code
description: Get a coupon by code. Looks up one coupon by its code, for example SAVE20. Case-insensitive. Allowed roles: owner, support.

name: coupons_deactivate
description: Deactivate a coupon. Switches a coupon off so new orders cannot use it. Past orders are not changed. Allowed roles: owner.

name: reports_sales
description: Sales summary for a period. Order count, gross, discounts, net revenue and average order value (all in cents) for orders placed in the period. Cancelled orders are counted separately and excluded from revenue. Defaults to the last 30 days. Allowed roles: owner.

from.description: Start of the period (inclusive), ISO 8601. Default: 30 days before now.

to.description: End of the period (exclusive), ISO 8601. Default: now.

name: reports_refunds
description: Refund summary for a period. Count and total of refunds requested in the period, broken down by status and by reason (amounts in cents). Defaults to the last 30 days. Allowed roles: owner.

from.description: Start of the period (inclusive), ISO 8601. Default: 30 days before now.

to.description: End of the period (exclusive), ISO 8601. Default: now.

name: forms_order_form
description: Get the order form. Describes the fields for orders_create right now: types, limits, where to look up valid values, coupon codes usable at this moment, and fields only your role may use. Read it before creating an order; the options change as data changes. Allowed roles: owner, support.
